landing.title: Pinneds
landing.tagline: One link. One game. Hosted by an AI you invent.
landing.body: Describe a host in one line, drop the link in your group chat, and play a photo game in the gaps of your day. Nothing to install.
landing.step1: The host sets a photo challenge — “Find the most suspicious object on your desk.”
landing.step2: Everyone submits privately whenever they get a minute. The host judges and teases.
landing.step3: Cut-outs are revealed, you guess whose is whose, and the host makes the poster.
landing.soon: The demo is coming next; creating a game is live now.
